name: codex-context-rollover
description: Records Codex compaction checkpoints and recommends a clean /new task after repeated compaction.

interface.longDescription: Records a verifiable transcript boundary after every Codex compaction. After repeated compaction, it warns about context distortion and task drift, then recommends starting a clean /new task.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain the compaction checkpoint status for this Codex task.
